'''Cerean wraidskin chestguards''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from the skin of [[wraid]]s and [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and black in color. Whether they were made by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] species or simply named for them is unknown. They were also identical in appearance to [[Huttese wraidskin chestguard]]s.
